import numpy as np
for p0 in [0.5,1,1.5,2,3,4,5]:
    m=np.abs(P-p0)<0.25
    if m.sum()<5: continue
    o=np.argsort(t[m])
    tt=t[m][o]; yy=dP_dt[m][o]
    # quadratic in t
    c=np.polyfit(tt,yy,2)
    print(p0, m.sum(), "t-quad coeffs", np.round(c,3), "rmse", round(np.sqrt(np.mean((np.polyval(c,tt)-yy)**2)),3), "range", round(yy.min(),2), round(yy.max(),2))
